classicCapture.recording: Exact captured species ID; additive first-time counter and200 stardust only once for each species; separate from shinies.
classicCapture.pool: Current native director.pool; no legendary or mythical species; animated sprite required; at least one eligible independent member not yet covered by profile.classics.
classicCapture.variantEligibility: Captured independent roster member covers only itself; a non-roster evolution may cover same-family roster members. League ownership is additionally required to equip.
classicCapture.spawnConflict: Does not replace active roaming, weakened or throwing capture; shiny scheduled branch has priority; ordinary scheduled classic blocked during coop.
limitations: Public static candidate source does not prove current account eligibility, RNG outcomes or server receipt.
Classic variants do not count as normal shiny collection.

rules.localPng: 本机 PNG 仅替换本客户端角色显示，不解锁或写入原生衣橱、经典异色、专属挑战奖励或账号收藏。
